remarks: Welcome to 19611 Gridley Rd. Home features. Remodeled kitchen with Island crown moldings and quartz counter tops. Recessed lighting throughout. Window shutters throughout. Living room with crown moldings. Engineered hardwood flooring throughout. hallway remodeled bathroom. Master bedroom with private bathroom. Covered patio with stamped concrete and planters. Iron gates. Front sprinkler system. Central air and heating. Front stone work including pillars. Drywalled garage with recessed lighting and attic space. Close to Middle and elementary ABC schools. walking distance to Cerritos mall and restaurants. Convenient access to freeways.
